title: A Method for Preserving Geometric Meaning in the Calculus of Variations
summary: We discuss the advantages of the Calculus of Moving Surfaces over the Euler-Lagrange equation for optimization problems originating in Geometry. An extension of Tensor Calculus, it provides tools for analyzing geometric quantities directly rather than their coordinate representations. This allows us to avoid the many difficulties associated with the use of coordinates, from the untenable complexity of analytical expressions to the virtual impossibility of recovering the geometric interpretation of the final result.
